_about: Every element the ElevenLabs scripts use. Scripts reference them as @@key@@ (css) or @@key.text@@. Fix a broken selector here, then run: python @modules/module_kit.py verify elevenLabs --write

main.description: Page main region; scope for the empty-state text.

history_empty_state.text: Submit a prompt to start your first project.
history_empty_state.description: Shown when the history list is truly empty (distinguishes 'empty' from 'still loading').

track_row.description: One generated project in the history list. Class-based: re-verify after ElevenLabs UI updates.

track_link.description: Project link. Its last path segment is the project id - the stable identity of a track.

track_text.description: Row text nodes; the duration is the one matching m:ss.

download_button.name: Download
download_button.description: Opens the format menu (Radix). Its id is the menu's aria-labelledby.

download_button_enabled.description: Download button that is enabled (track finished).

more_button.name: More
more_button.description: Opens the project menu with 'Delete project'. Its id is the menu's aria-labelledby.

track_busy.description: Present while the track is still generating; a busy track is not ready.

track_badge.description: Our own highlight badge (added by highlight_track_card), not part of ElevenLabs.

open_menu.description: An open Radix menu. Match it to its trigger with aria-labelledby == trigger button id.

mp3_menu_item.name: MP3
mp3_menu_item.description: Download menu entry for MP3 (exact text, not disabled).

delete_menu_item.name: Delete project
delete_menu_item.description: Project menu entry that opens the delete confirmation.

delete_confirm_button.name: Delete
delete_confirm_button.description: Red 'Delete' (class text-error) in the dialog whose text contains Delete "<title>". The class tells it apart from other Delete-labelled buttons.

delete_dialog_question.text: Are you sure you'd like to delete this project?
delete_dialog_question.description: Body text of the delete confirmation; used to find its Cancel button.

music_model_button.name: Music model
music_model_button.description: Opens the model picker; its text is the current model.

music_model_tooltip.description: Confirms the button is the model picker (not another 'Music model' label).

model_option.description: Entries of the open model picker; the wanted one starts with settings.music_model.

prompt_editor.description: Tiptap editor; element.editor exposes getJSON() and commands.setContent with promptRegion + lyricsRegion.

prompt_region.description: Prompt text region inside the editor (read to verify the prompt).

generate_button.name: Generate
generate_button.description: Submits the prompt. data-loading='true' while generating. Spends credits.

generate_loading.description: Generate is still working on a submission - the app is busy.
